title: Expose explicit fork / alternate timeline CLI UX
description: The normal fork case (not the future-detour case): a CLI surface over the core forkCharacterTimeline from eshyra-lupf.14.3, plus choosing a non-head revision to fork/check out. Folds in the earlier 14.3 follow-up scope. Parent: eshyra-lupf.14.4; depends on eshyra-lupf.14.4.1.
acceptance_criteria:
- User can fork a character from head or a selected revision into a new globalCharacterId.
- CLI explains that this breaks continuity.
- Forked character starts with revision 1 and parent provenance.
- Existing registry identity remains unchanged.
- Tests cover refusing overwrite and selecting a non-head revision.
